notes_for_editor: Single-source record: the register is the only source with content. Two web searches found nothing on the site. The californialookouts.weebly.com Hellister Point page was read but holds only a title and menu, so it is not cited. The Placer County lookout page returned HTTP 403. The register's Removed field (Circa 1982) and its text (removal date unknown) disagree; facts and events follow the text, with 1982 kept only in corrections. No photo URL was found for the June 1964 photo credited to the Mark Swift Collection, so photos are omitted. No staffing or access source was found.
